Spray Dried Strawberry Powder for Beverage, Dairy and Confectionery Use

Our spray dried strawberry powder brings concentrated berry flavor and a soft pink-red color to food and drink products. We make it by spray drying strawberry puree into a fine, soluble powder. The process keeps the sweet, fruity aroma of fresh strawberries. Food manufacturers get the same result batch after batch. As a spray dried strawberry powder manufacturer, Tradenest Naturals works to a written specification on every lot.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Strawberry Powder?

Consistency matters in a competitive ingredient market. That is why we pay close attention to raw material. Ripe strawberries are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The fruit is pureed and passed through a controlled spray drying cycle. This turns the puree into a fine powder that dissolves readily. Full composition details, including any drying carrier, are on the specification sheet. This helps brands working on clean-label products check fit early.

Advanced Manufacturing and Quality Control

Food safety is part of each step. First, our team checks the incoming fruit for ripeness and quality. Second, drying temperatures are closely controlled to protect color and flavor. Our facility also follows written SOPs to prevent cross-contamination. Each lot carries a batch number for traceability. As a spray dried strawberry powder exporter, we check every batch for moisture and mesh. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Versatile Industrial Applications

The powder is used in many sectors. Beverage makers use it in instant fruit drinks and smoothies. Confectioners use it to flavor candies and fillings. Dairy producers add it to yogurt, ice cream and milkshakes. It also works well in bakery mixes and supplement powders. In short, it is a flexible fruit ingredient for modern food production.

Technical Specifications and Buyer Information

B2B buyers need clear data to make good decisions. Here are answers to common questions about buying from us:
  • What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger orders receive better pricing.
  • What are the typical specifications? The standard grade is spray dried, 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%.
  • What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer moisture-resistant packing from 1 kg packs to 25 kg bulk bags. Shelf life is 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place.
  • How do I request a sample or quote? Contact our sales team through our website. Samples are available on request, and we reply to quote requests quickly.
Whether you need a bulk spray dried strawberry powder supplier India can offer or a long-term global partner, Tradenest Naturals ships worldwide from India. We help you bring real fruit flavor to your products.
